# NestJS

> NestJS is a TypeScript framework for building backends on Node.js, from a small API in one file to a large system with many teams. It gives an application modules, dependency injection, and first-party packages for most of what a backend needs. This file points to the official documentation.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://docs.nestjs.com/llms.txt): every chapter, with a markdown page per chapter, and where to start by what you're building
- [Full documentation](https://docs.nestjs.com/llms-full.txt): every chapter in one file
- [First steps](https://docs.nestjs.com/first-steps.md): create a project and write a first controller

## Moving to Nest

- [From Express](https://docs.nestjs.com/recipes/express-migration.md): one route at a time or all at once
- [From Fastify](https://docs.nestjs.com/recipes/fastify-migration.md): keeping your plugins
- [As the backend of a Next.js app](https://docs.nestjs.com/recipes/nextjs.md): moving route handlers across one by one

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/nestjs/nest)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nestjs/core)
